messages:
jules: quick design request 3 can we add a tiny cost-preview hovercard on SKU hover in Console? idea: show estimated per-model marginal cost + cache savings if you change routing policy (sticky vs round-robin). mock pending.

sam: love it. reduces surprise during rollout flips. :thumbsup:

katie: UX question: default window 7d or something shorter? needs to align with billing cadence.

jules: 7d default with a small confidence band. label it 'preview, not invoice'. show breakdown gen vs embeddings tokens.

pranav: cache savings will be noisy because of sequence-shape variance. we should include sample_rate and a variance indicator. otherwise eng will distrust it.

maria: product wants an internal API so support and SRE can pull the same preview data. internal-only endpoint is fine.

sam: proposed API: GET /internal/console/cost_preview?route=R123&policy=sticky&window=7d will return a compact payload: model_summaries, total_token_delta, est_cost_delta_cents, sample_rate.

pranav: security note: avoid returning raw cents for multi-tenant aggregated queries. return per-unit metrics and let UI format currency. include sequence_shape_bucket in metadata.

katie: UX needs: headline (e.g. "~$0.30/day saved" rounded with confidence), expandable micro-breakdown (per-model lines, cache vs model-run). headline must be short.

jules: add a small "view assumptions" link that opens modal with sampling windows and hedging rules.

maria: ops-bot question: previews might spike telemetry during big rollouts. can we throttle and cache previews for 60s?

ops-bot: deploy-bot: recommend 60s LRU caching. we have internal cache service at /internal/cache-preview supporting 64k keys. requests must use X-Internal-Key.

pranav: make cache key = route_id|policy|sample_rate|client_tz to avoid confusing stale previews. also include decision_path_id for tie-back to rollout experiments.

sam: include decision_id in the API so we can trace which preview was shown and later correlate telemetry.

katie: should we show GPU-time or keep that in advanced view? product leans both but UX prefers simple headline + advanced toggle.

jules: keep GPU time in 'advanced metrics'. headline stays token/cost focused.

maria: what staleness is acceptable? 30s, 1m? impacts cache TTL choice.

pranav: 30s is reasonable for most routes. heavy routes can sample less frequently. show a small freshness indicator (fresh/cached).

sam: implementation note: reuse econ microservice that does per-invocation token attribution; add a lightweight aggregator that approximates 7d deltas to avoid heavy rollups.

maria: add feature flagging per-org to opt-out (privacy/compliance). ops needs that before rollout.

jules: final UX flow: if user tweaks policy in modal, update preview in-place and provide an 'apply to rollout' snapshot button.

pranav: caveat 3 sticky routing impacts cache locality; preview must include a short-term warmup projection (0-24h) showing expected temporary negative delta until caches warm.

katie: we'll add a 24h sparkline for warmup curve with a small annotation.

sam: action items: 1) prana/eng: prototype API + cache; 2) sam/frontend: hovercard mock + interactions; 3) product: finalize copy + confidence language; 4) ops: quota/throttle rules + feature flag gating.

maria: i'll open a GH issue with acceptance criteria, link mock and add ops constraints.

jules: thanks all 3 ping when GH issue exists. should cut down on surprise burn during experiments. :party_popper:
